GQ.name: Impuesto sobre Bienes Inmuebles, urban property (0,05 % of 30 % of land and building value)
GQ.doc: art. 213 1): for urban property the taxable base is 30 % of the sum of the values of land and building (30 % of the price of a transfer in the previous year); art. 214 1): rate 0,05 % of that base, i.e. 0,015 % of the value, applied in one step (15 / 100 000). The household's holdings are taken as urban property in Malabo or Bata (no regional rebate).
unsupported: rebates of 40 % / 60 % / 100 % outside Malabo and Bata (art. 211)
